objective: Introduce optional Cantonese n/l contrast practice in the community's designated creator ads thread.

source_evidence.google_pricing: Free download with in-app purchases; exact purchase price is not advertised.

reddit.community_fit: The moderator-created thread explicitly invites creators to introduce their own Cantonese teaching resources. Ordinary threads prohibit solicitation. The copy describes voluntary contrast practice without disparaging colloquial n/l merging.
reddit.content:
I built L & N because I mix up these sounds myself. If you want to practise keeping n- and l- distinct, the Cantonese section has pairs such as 男 naam4 / 藍 laam4.

You can listen to each word, record yourself, then replay your take and see what the speech recognizer heard. There's also a listening round: hear a short sequence of the two words and tap which ones you heard. I find that part especially useful for my own practice.

No account or ads. It also has Mandarin and English exercises.

iPhone/iPad — US$0.99: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/l-n-speech-practice/id6808872450

Android — free download, with in-app purchases: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=art.lazying.landn

follow_up.next_action: Inspect a genuine response when notified. Do not repeat the introduction in other ads threads or insert a pitch into ordinary Cantonese questions.

funnel.policy: Public visibility is distribution evidence, not an installation, learning outcome or purchase.
